selected_concept: At dawn in a fog-fed coastal barchan field, an adult documentary traveler uses a saffron wind streamer while a crosswind pulse visibly carries sand from a rippled windward slope across a sharp crest into a lee-face avalanche. A wide oblique environmental portrait keeps the complete dune structure dominant and the reference-guided face visible at small scale.
